name: Fixed Income
description: Bonds: features, pricing, yield measures, term structure, credit analysis, securitisation. The other side of capital markets — debt rather than equity.
draftFlag: LOS list authored from training knowledge; verify against current CFA Institute Level 1 syllabus.

los.statement: describe the features of a fixed-income security

describe the features and characteristics of debt securities issued by non-sovereign governments, quasi-government entities, and supranational agencies
